dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 17, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: Dominant Performances Across the League**

A day of thrilling matchups saw some incredible individual performances that stole the show. In the Boston Red Sox' 10-0 thrashing of the Tampa Bay Rays, Carlos Narváez led the charge, hitting three home runs and driving in three runs. Narváez's power was matched by Wilyer Abreu, who hit two home runs and drove in three runs in the Red Sox' second game against the Rays.

On the mound, Jake Bennett was nearly unhittable, throwing six scoreless innings with three strikeouts in the Red Sox' first game. Gerrit Cole was equally impressive, striking out eight in six innings for the Los Angeles Dodgers in their 2-1 win over the New York Yankees. Chris Sale dominated the Texas Rangers, allowing just two hits in seven scoreless innings for the Atlanta Braves.

In other notable performances, Andrés Chaparro hit a pair of home runs and drove in eight runs for the Washington Nationals in their 23-4 rout of the Athletics, while Spencer Steer hit two home runs and drove in three runs for the Cincinnati Reds in their 7-2 win over the Colorado Rockies.
